bio: Second-year B.Tech CSE student at T.K.M. College of Engineering, Kollam, interested in frontend development and data science. I like turning everyday problems into working web projects, and I'm currently building a digital wardrobe sharing platform.

involvement.note: Part of the core team organising club activities.
Built and published this portfolio with Git, GitHub Pages and an automated pull request.

projects.title: Wardrobe Randomizer + Networking
projects.desc: A web platform where users digitize their wardrobe, get auto-generated outfit combinations, and borrow items from nearby people instead of buying new ones.
features: Digital wardrobe: upload clothes and accessories to build a personal catalog
Outfit generator that randomizes combinations from your own items
Peer-to-peer lending with no money exchanged, for in-person nearby exchanges
AI image check comparing an item's condition before lending and after return
Uber-style user ratings that drop when damage is flagged
Complaint and compensation module for disputes over lent items
Thrift store add-on for buying and selling small items and accessories
AI product suggestions with affiliate links (Amazon, Myntra)
projects.status: Pilot with a group of 4 people; courier-based expansion planned
